factions.name: The Kingdom of Cyrel
factions.summary: A stubborn fortress kingdom of three sister cities, fighting on two fronts and logging a third.
goals: Beat Asania, or at least not lose
Cut the timber the war needs

clocks.name: War levy
clocks.done: Cyrel's war levy reaches the sister towns: every household gives a son to Bastion or pays three crowns, and the crimps are out on the roads for those who run.

clocks.name: Retake Adlmyr
clocks.done: Cyrel's army storms Adlmyr and takes the fallen walls back from the Unguruk. The road through the Badlands is Cyrel's again, for now, and the graves outside Bastion are new.

jobs.title: A deserter in the woods
jobs.hook: The reeve's men want a deserter from Bastion found before the levy officer arrives: a local boy, hiding somewhere in the woods with a stolen cloak.
jobs.truth: He ran because his sergeant sold the company's winter boots, and he can prove it. The sergeant has friends in Cyrel who would rather the boy hanged quietly.
jobs.missed: The levy officer came and found no deserter, so he hanged the boy's father in his place.

jobs.title: The levy rolls to Eriane
jobs.hook: The reeve needs the levy rolls carried to the magistrate in Eriane within four days, and trusts no carter with them.
jobs.truth: Half the names on the rolls were bought off. Someone in Eriane will pay well for the true list, and the reeve's own nephew is not on it.
jobs.missed: The rolls never reached Eriane. Cyrel's magistrate has written to ask why, and the reeve's name is mud.

jobs.title: The tax cart on the Eriane road
jobs.hook: The quarter's tax cart left for Cyrel with two guards and never reached Eriane. The reeve wants the silver back, or the names of whoever took it, before Cyrel sends someone to ask.
jobs.truth: The guards drove the cart into the Badlands themselves and sold the silver to Unguruk traders. One is buried by the road where they quarrelled over it; the other bought a farm in his brother's name.
jobs.missed: Cyrel's assessor came and took the shortfall out of Kingswood, house by house. The reeve kept his post by naming a widow as the thief.

jobs.title: Terms at Adlmyr
jobs.hook: Cyrel wants its sealed terms carried into Adlmyr and put in the war-chief's hand, by someone the Unguruk will not take for a soldier.
jobs.truth: The terms are a stall. The army marches on Adlmyr while the war-chief reads them, and the one who carried them is meant to be inside the walls when it does.
jobs.missed: No envoy went. The army marched anyway, and the levy officer wrote that Kingswood refused the crown's errand.

factions.name: The Kingdom of Asania
factions.summary: Splendid, magical, land-hungry and always ready for war. Allied with Trein's sorcerers, careful around Wrenspire.
goals: Stay first among the Kingdoms of Man

clocks.name: Push across the Cyrel border
clocks.done: Asania's army crosses the border on the lake road. Eriane burns, and refugees choke the Cyrel road all the way to Kingswood.

factions.name: The Cyrel Timber Guild
factions.summary: The guild that owns Kingswood's cutting crews and most of its debts. It has bought the Heartwood cutting rights from the town's reeve, in secret.
goals: Fell the Heartwood before the season ends

clocks.name: Buy out the sawmill
clocks.done: The Timber Guild buys Kingswood's sawmill outright. Wages drop by a fifth the same week, and the men who complain are not taken on again.

jobs.title: A debt at Cutters' Camp
jobs.hook: The Guild factor wants a feller's debt collected, nine crowns, by any means short of murder.
jobs.truth: The feller borrowed to bury his wife. The factor took a cut of the undertaker's fee as well, and keeps a second ledger nobody is meant to see.
jobs.missed: The Guild sent its own men. The feller lost two fingers and his place on the crews.

jobs.title: Who breaks the saws
jobs.hook: Someone has been breaking the big saws at the mill by night. The Guild pays well for a name.
jobs.truth: It is the factor's own nephew, paid by friends of the elves in town to slow the felling.
jobs.missed: The Guild blamed the night watchman and turned him out. The saws keep breaking.

jobs.title: The Mossrun survey
jobs.hook: The Guild wants its surveyor taken safely to Mossrun and back, to judge the timber on the hills the diggers say are theirs.
jobs.truth: The surveyor's satchel holds Guild gold for the Deep Nine's foreman, to look away while the Guild cuts. The foreman has already taken money from someone else to do the opposite.
jobs.missed: The surveyor went alone and came back without the satchel or two of his teeth. The Guild says he was robbed by the character, whoever asks.

factions.name: The High Elves of Brynwyr
factions.summary: A closed, ancient people defending their forest from Cyrel and its loggers, with wardens on the land and sea-elves on the water.

clocks.name: Move the border stones
clocks.done: The wardens of Brynwyr move the border stones a mile toward Kingswood in one night, and shoot anyone who tries to move them back.

jobs.title: A message past the stones
jobs.hook: A grey-fletched arrow came with a strip of bark: whoever carries a message to the reeve and keeps quiet about it will be remembered past the stones.
jobs.truth: The message names the night the wardens mean to burn the camp if the felling goes ahead. The reeve already knows, and has told no one.
jobs.missed: No one carried the message. The wardens take the silence for an answer.

jobs.title: Bones under the felling line
jobs.hook: The wardens say the Guild's crews cut through a barrow past the stones. They want proof they can lay before the reeve, and they will not cross the line to get it themselves.
jobs.truth: The crews did cut through it, and filled it in. Under the elven dead lie older ones: men in Brotherhood mail, killed with elven arrows, which neither side wants found.
jobs.missed: The wardens took their own proof: a felling crew, left hanging in the trees along the line.

factions.name: The Unguruk Tribe
factions.summary: Orcs, half-orcs and human exiles in a walled camp at the heart of the Badlands. Proud, tough, and nursing a long grudge against Cyrel.

clocks.name: Siege works at Adlmyr
clocks.done: The Unguruk finish their works at Adlmyr and start raiding past the ward-keep. Smoke rises from the farms on the Kingswood road.

factions.name: The Mossrun Expedition
factions.summary: A mining concern grown over five generations from two strikes, one iron and one Ley crystal, into an empire of mines serving several cities. Run by the Ilvar family, whose wives die in childbirth and whose fathers are always dying when the children come home.

clocks.name: The Deep Nine reaches what it is digging toward
clocks.done: The Deep Nine breaks into something old under Mossrun. The shaft is sealed with the night shift still in it, and the miners who came up will not say what they heard.
